candidate.notes: Released on the maintainer's instruction ('go ahead and send it all', 2026-10-28) without a fresh install test of these exact files; every console check is waived in writing below. What backs it: the supporter build of the same source has been with supporters for eleven days, and the dev builds were run on the console (photo viewer, screensaver, 1080p60 at 44-45 fps, Settings, update from the developer server). The console freezes seen in the dev builds were traced to the maintainer's GPU overclock (710 MHz), not the app. The public source is the supporter source (boundary check clean, pull request #54 checks passed). Tiramisu is untested and the release notes say so. Issue #55 (freeze when cancelling a search, 2026-10-23) came without a version or device and is being asked about; it is not shown to be a regression of this release.
